read_scope: Primary preprint abstract and bibliographic context, following withdrawn duplicate1710.05086 to its replacement; PMC browser challenge and Nature redirect prevented full-text access in this review.
hypothesis: A count-aware conditional mean objective may differ from squared regression of log-positive expression. Isolate this on the frozen flow and global detection.
implementation: Positive-only log-link Poisson mean objective with L2 slopes, unpenalized intercept, Newton/backtracking; ridge.1/1, at most12 steps. Input is expm1 of library-normalized expression, fractional rather than raw UMI counts; use quasi-likelihood interpretation only.
limitations: Own decoder ablation, not scVI reproduction, a negative-binomial generative architecture, raw-count likelihood, or zero-truncated Poisson model. Detection is modeled separately and only observed-positive cells fit the mean. No calibrated biological uncertainty claimed. Full architecture/count models remain open.
